content.title: MX-T (Mixed-Use, Transit) District
content.summary: The MX-T (Mixed-Use, Transit) District is designed for high-density residential and non-residential developments along transit corridors, allowing for a mix of uses on single parcels or in master-planned areas. Various uses are categorized as Allowed Use By-Right, Limited Use, or Conditional Use, with specific regulations outlined in the Land Development Code for each classification across residential, hospitality, commercial, community, industrial, motor vehicle, and utility sectors.
content.body:
Intended to provide for urban-scale, higher density residential and non-residential uses in vertically or horizontally mixed development on a single parcel or in a master planned area, and located along corridors with frequent bus and rail transit service.

Acronyms:

- Allowed Use By-Right (A)
- Limited Use (L)
- Conditional Use (C)

**Note**: If a use is not listed in the table then it is not allowed in the zoning district
